introduction.purpose: This document specifies the functional and non-functional requirements for Untitled App, a multimodal project intake and requirements specification generation system. It serves as the definitive guide for developers, testers, and stakeholders to understand system capabilities, constraints, and implementation details.

product_scope.summary: Untitled App is a web-based application that facilitates project initiation through multiple input modalities, processes user inputs via guided interviews, and automatically generates IEEE-compliant Software Requirements Specifications. The system supports text entry, file uploads, and voice input for comprehensive project documentation.
business_objectives: Streamline project initiation and requirements gathering processes
Reduce ambiguity in early project documentation
Provide standardized SRS output in multiple formats
Support non-technical users through guided workflows
benefits: Reduces manual effort in SRS creation
Enhances collaboration between technical and non-technical stakeholders
goals: Deliver a fully functional web application supporting multimodal input
Generate compliant IEEE SRS documents automatically
Support JSON and PDF export capabilities
Maintain under 2-second response times for core operations

product_perspective.system_context: Untitled App operates as a standalone web application delivered through modern browsers, featuring a responsive frontend, RESTful API services, persistent data storage, and AI-powered processing capabilities for requirements generation and validation.

functional_requirements.title: Text Input Handling
functional_requirements.description: The system shall accept and validate text input for project descriptions and requirements
acceptance_criteria: Text input fields accept alphanumeric characters and special symbols
Input validation provides clear error messages for invalid entries
Text content is persisted and available for subsequent processing

functional_requirements.title: File Upload Processing
functional_requirements.description: The system shall support uploading and processing of common document formats
acceptance_criteria: Multiple file types accepted (PDF, DOCX, TXT, images)
File size limits enforced with appropriate error messages
Upload progress and status clearly displayed to user

description_and_priority.description: Presents structured interview questions to users and captures responses for comprehensive requirements analysis

stimulus_response_sequences.system_response: The system processes the request and shows a clear status update.
postconditions: The updated result is available for review.

functional_requirements.title: Question Presentation
functional_requirements.description: The system shall present questions in logical sequence with progress indication
acceptance_criteria: Questions displayed one at a time with clear navigation
Users can review and modify previous answers

functional_requirements.title: Answer Validation
functional_requirements.description: The system shall validate user responses for completeness and consistency
acceptance_criteria: Required questions must be answered before proceeding
Input validation checks for format and content requirements
Clear error messages guide users to correct invalid inputs

description_and_priority.description: Automatically generates IEEE-compliant Software Requirements Specifications from collected project data

stimulus_response_sequences.system_response: The system processes the request and shows a clear status update.
postconditions: The updated result is available for review.

functional_requirements.title: JSON SRS Generation
functional_requirements.description: The system shall generate machine-readable JSON format SRS documents
acceptance_criteria: JSON output follows IEEE SRS structure standards
All collected project data included in structured format
JSON schema validation ensures output consistency

functional_requirements.title: PDF Document Creation
functional_requirements.description: The system shall generate formatted PDF documents from SRS content
acceptance_criteria: PDF includes proper formatting and styling
All sections from JSON SRS included in human-readable format
PDF generation maintains data integrity and formatting

performance_requirements.description: Page loads and API responses shall complete within 2 seconds under normal load conditions
File upload processing shall handle files up to 50MB without significant performance degradation
SRS generation shall complete within 30 seconds for typical project sizes
System shall support concurrent usage by multiple users without performance impact

safety_requirements.description: The system shall prevent accidental loss of active project work.
safety_requirements.hazard: Loss of project inputs or artifacts

security_requirements.description: All data transmissions shall use TLS 1.2+ encryption
User authentication and authorization shall be implemented for sensitive operations
Uploaded files shall be scanned for malware before processing
Session data shall be encrypted at rest using industry-standard encryption
Access controls shall prevent unauthorized access to project data and artifacts

software_quality_attributes.description: Non-technical users should complete the intake and answer flow without training.

business_rules.description: Projects require minimum completion of core sections before SRS generation
Artifact export only available for validated and complete SRS documents
User sessions expire after 24 hours of inactivity with data preservation
File uploads are subject to type and size restrictions based on security policies

database_requirements.description: Database shall store session data, user inputs, uploaded file metadata, and generated artifacts
Data retention policies shall be configurable with automatic cleanup of expired sessions
Database backups shall be performed daily with point-in-time recovery capability
Database shall support concurrent read/write operations with proper transaction handling

internationalization_requirements.description: The product should support future localization without changing the API contract.
locale_rules: ISO date formatting for API payloads

legal_requirements.description: System shall comply with data protection regulations for user data handling
Privacy policy shall clearly state data collection, storage, and usage practices
Terms of service shall outline user rights and responsibilities
Copyright and intellectual property rights for generated content shall be clearly defined

reuse_objectives.description: Reuse question planning, validation, and export modules across future agents.

additional_requirements.description: System shall provide comprehensive logging for audit trails and debugging
Error handling shall provide user-friendly messages with technical details for support
Internationalization support shall be built-in for future localization needs
API endpoints shall follow RESTful design principles with proper versioning

analysis_models.description: Summarises AI-driven questions, user answers, and completion coverage for the current SRS.
Summarises service responsibilities and handoff boundaries for the current build phase.

services.summary: Central routing service handling all frontend requests, authentication, and request validation
Manages session state, user answers, and project metadata with persistence and retrieval capabilities
Handles generation and delivery of JSON and PDF artifacts with proper formatting and validation
Performs AI-powered analysis and SRS generation from collected project inputs and interview responses

analyst_workspace.analysis_summary: This Software Requirements Specification defines the requirements for Untitled App, a web-based application designed to streamline project intake and requirements gathering through multimodal input capabilities. The system enables users to submit project ideas via text, file uploads, and voice input, processes these inputs through guided interviews, and generates structured Software Requirements Specifications in both JSON and PDF formats. The application targets general users with basic digital literacy and provides a responsive web interface with secure data handling and export capabilities.
